name: ascenda
description: Cognitive performance and AI-work telemetry for VS Code and Cursor.

ascenda.eventLogFile.markdownDescription: Append every event to this file as JSON Lines — the exact payload sent, plus how delivery went. Empty disables it. `~` is expanded. Overridden by the `ASCENDA_EVENT_LOG_FILE` environment variable.

ascenda.telemetry.enabled.description: Enable privacy-safe AI workload telemetry collection.

ascenda.telemetry.captureEditorActivity.description: Capture privacy-safe editor activity events such as saves and changed line buckets. Raw source code is never sent.

ascenda.telemetry.captureTerminalCommand.description: Capture privacy-safe terminal command classes when VS Code shell integration exposes command execution events. Raw terminal output is never sent.

ascenda.telemetry.afterHoursStart.description: Local time when after-hours monitoring begins, HH:mm.

ascenda.telemetry.afterHoursEnd.description: Local time when after-hours monitoring ends, HH:mm.

ascenda.telemetry.flushIntervalSeconds.description: How frequently telemetry events are flushed to the backend.

ascenda.telemetry.drainPersistedQueue.markdownDescription: Re-send telemetry that a previous editor session could not deliver and left on disk. Off by default until the backend is confirmed to deduplicate on `idempotencyKey`; while off, the backlog is kept on disk (and bounded) but never sent.

ascenda.telemetry.queueMaxEntries.description: Most undelivered events kept on disk. The oldest are discarded beyond this, and every discard is written to the Ascenda Telemetry output channel.

ascenda.telemetry.queueMaxAgeDays.description: Undelivered events older than this are discarded rather than re-sent. Every discard is written to the Ascenda Telemetry output channel.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm --prefix .. run build:shared && tsc --noEmit && npm run bundle
